caseName: West India Oil Co. (Puerto Rico) v. Bonet, Treasurer of Puerto Rico
caseNameFull: West India Oil Company (Puerto Rico) v. Rafael Sancho Bonet, Treasurer of Puerto Rico

opinions.text: Manuel V. Domenech, present Treasurer of Puerto Rico; substituted as the party respondent herein in the place and stead of Rafael Sancho Bonet, former Treasurer, on motion of Mr. James R. Beverley for the petitioner.* -
